target.# comment: Mapped against the game by waveform (lag per window, then per-copy least squares): the game plays the recording at +1.520297 s (copy A; the old 1.52 was 13 samples off) as the UNFADED master right through the album's fade (A correlates 0.96-0.97 to game 116 s while the album is already 30 dB down), then from ~111 s the same material one repeat back (B, lag -13.248922; A and B correlate 0.99 with each other at 113-114.5 s), a hard cut at 121.88 s to lag -74.1873 (D) with B fading under it for ~0.7 s, and at 125.44 s the head copy one loop length back (C, lag -72.325803 = A - loop length, so the wrap is continuous by construction) summed with D's bass, which rings on to ~127.3 s while D's highs are gone (above 640 Hz D correlates 0.82 at 125.4 s and 0.05-0.2 after 125.6 s). The old layout crossfaded 12 s from 98.78 s into B, mixing in material the game does not play (build-vs-game correlation fell to -0.1..-0.45 from 108 s on), with B 5.8 ms off, and ran B into the recording's silent end (hole 54.5 dB at 131.3 s). Now: A with the album fade undone (energy ratio against the game per 0.25 s, smoothed and monotone, an aeval gain in recording time, the same filter on every segment since B also reads into the fade); B from 112.5 s with a 0.5 s linear crossfade; from 121.88 s one segment whose filter sums B (linear fade-out 0.7 s), D (full to 125.44 s), D's bass (firequalizer below 640 Hz, its 10 ms delay taken off the adelay, fading out at 127.19-127.39 s) and C (in at 125.44 s), with alimiter at the recording's own peak (0.8603) so the sum's peaks do not make apply back the whole file off (unlimited: -3.8 dB peak back-off). Against the game's own file: weighted 0.9837 -> 0.9952, hole 54.5 -> 1.05 dB, tail 0.912 -> 0.982 vs control 0.999, level -1.68 -> -1.52 dB (p90 2.64 -> 1.65), joins clean; build-vs-game waveform correlation 0.96-0.97 everywhere except 121.5-122.5 s (0.75-0.91: the game there is only ~0.77 explained by B+D under any envelope tried) and 126-126.5 s (0.93; the game's highs there match nothing in the recording, best 0.3-0.5 -- not filled from "target" because the bass under them is on the recording). verify's join detector cannot model this item (a waveform filter inside an asplit branch); the same layout without the bass-only D branch is modelled, clears the 110 s / 5.8 ms finding, and flags only D's highs at 126.8 s (weighted 0.9934, tail 0.965).
